about: "Love Is All Around" is a simulating love story real-life full-motion interactive video .
You will not only meet but also fall in love with six beauties with completely different personalities and styles, eventually embark on an immersive and sweet journey one after another.
Under their charisma, how would you deal with the six beauties while you are busy at paying off debts? Would you  ignore your feelings and focus on making money? Or would you choose love over money?
Among these beauties, who would you choose to be your partner for the rest of your life?
Is it the extremely charming ingenue girl?
Is it the mature girl with intellectual tenderness and gentleness?
summary: Simulating Love Story Real-life Full-motion Interactive Video
